ordinary_MOSS_path_assessment.scheduler: New complete_without_generation method defaults to None and MOSS does not override it; build/stream session branches remain inactive when active_session_unit is None. Embedding clearing moves after close_completed_request; ordinary request cleanup detaches same request data and no session history is committed. No changed sampling, admission, batch policy or GPU kernels for ordinary MOSS.
ordinary_MOSS_path_assessment.vocoder: Metadata scan returns None for every ordinary payload, preserving order into the superclass. Session maps empty, emitted audio payload uses the original stream_payload method. New dict lookups/no-op session cleanup are common overhead; no graph/pacing/control or model state is invoked.
ordinary_MOSS_path_assessment.stage_runtime: Session preempt/forward conditions false. Fixed MOSS routes resolve to the same next stages; get_next is merely hoisted before unchanged ordinary ownership branch.
ordinary_MOSS_path_assessment.coordinator: SessionGraphRunner adds only session methods, inherits the same ordinary submission/completion. Graph/pacer tasks start through open_session/open_graph which benchmark never calls. Counts admission field defaults true for all ordinary requests; no bypass operations in benchmark.
ordinary_MOSS_path_assessment.config: MOSS has empty session_nodes, session_graph returns None. Ordinary API does not create SessionOperation metadata.
ordinary_MOSS_path_assessment.ar_session_and_request_data: All changed bridge methods require a SessionUnit/operation; new projected-prefill helper is not called by MOSS.

decision: Reuse frozen-main paired performance evidence with exact original identity: upstream changes introduce guarded Session functionality without changing ordinary MOSS generation/stream semantics. Validate a clean current-main synthetic merge with full MOSS and affected shared regressions before merge. Do not claim measured throughput at5789.
known_scope_limit: Performance timings are reused on actual frozen2d5; new shared Session guards add small unmeasured common Python overhead at5789. No claim of throughput measured at5789. Integration tests establish compatibility, not a new timing result.
